name: Human
description: The best way to imagine or best visualize a human is to look around you or in a mirror. Take a deep breath and prepare to play the same thing you are every day, if you’re looking for a simple role-playing base, well then humans are for you. Humans are us and so play the largest role in the game, whole campaigns have been human only campaigns. Humans are also the largest population of humanoids throughout the earth and so should be part of almost every major event in the world.
backstory: Humans of DV6 are still extremely versatile and live many different types of lives, there are only three major types of humans throughout the world: Slaves, Wasters and City Folk. Slaves have it the worst, everything that has come to the world since the apocalypse has taken human slaves. The Demon Hordes of Asia and Canada, the Wolfin Empire, the Dwarven kingdom of Mozzark, the pirates of the Dragon Isles, the Egyptian Gods of Africa, the Black Throne Orcs and Russian Orc Tribes, other humans, all enslave the poor humans. Wasters are those that dare to live in the harsh immense wastelands left throughout the world by the atomic devastation. They live vastly different lives, every day is a struggle just to survive, if the monsters and demons don't get you, then starvation and dehydration will. Communities are few and far between and are extremely edgy of outsiders. The term Waster is a generality and used for almost any humanoids traveling through the waste. City Folk live in one of the many great Mega-cities living sheltered lives, in a retro steam punk environment, riddled with crime, corruption, but policed by the dreaded Judges.

name: Elf
description: Elves resemble humans in every way except for pointed ears and wild hair, eye and skin colors, they are slender, beautiful races that cannot grow facial hair. They are a pompous, smug people that love to remind the other races that they are superior and have been alive for eons and have never caused the destruction of their world, however despite this humans and elves are able to interbreed and birth children. The general elf population seriously frowns on interbreeding and strips those who commit it of their social standing and family name. There are currently at least a dozen known Elven sub-races on earth: Star, Winter, Dark, Jungle, Wood, High, Aquatic, Blood, Rune and True elves.
backstory: Elves are an ancient race from a time long ago; they lived during the Age of magic and have returned to the earth through tears in time. They are as diverse as humans with many dialects and traditions, the High Elves claim the oldest linage, with all other Elven sub races ruling themselves from within. Elves are masters of Spells and magics having created most modern magic as we know it, however the magic was long ago regulated and only taught in schools. So, most of the elf populace have no magic knowledge at all, only the well train elite wizards of the Mages Guild. Those that show natural ability are sought out and taken away to school where their talents can be nurtured and controlled. The Elven communities on earth are the Thistle Kingdom in Ireland ruled by the High Lord Magus, Mega City 12, Light Town located in what was the state of Maryland and the Council of the Sun near old Italy.

name: Dwarf
description:
Dwarves are a short stout race of mountain people that resemble humans in every way, except for size. There are several Dwarven sub races on earth, Mountain, Hill, Steppe and Deep. Dwarven society is a strict caste system, they are a greed driven race of miners, for a Dwarf their beard is their pride and their caste usually determines the length and style of their facial hair. The caste system is the following:
  • King/Paragon
  • Assembly Members
  • Noble Houses
  • Smiths & Warriors Houses
  • Merchant caste & Gnomish Tinker's Guild
  • The Castless, Top Siders, everyone else
backstory: There are several communities of Dwarves currently residing on earth. The Kingdom of Mozzark is in the old Czech Republic, the entire kingdom Mozzark and the mountain range it resides in were phased into our dimension and now rule the area but welcome all races that seek refuge. Deep Town is buried deep in the earth, awakened by the great crack that opened along the western seaboard of North America. Mega City 28 was invaded by the Dwarven raider tribes, every human was slaughtered during the two-year siege of the city and is now ruled by several tribal lords that each own sections of the city. Hill dwarves are exiled mountain Dwarves that formed their own society and always except new Dwarves into their fold. The kingdom of Pumpernickel in along the Canadian/American border in the west and Pax Uthal in eastern Texas.

name: Gnome
description: Gnomes are tiny humanoids that resemble humans in every way except for the fact that every gnome is 2 feet tall. Gnomes coexist in the Dwarven society and have no society of their own. Gnomes come in 3 types Workers, Tinkers and the Mad. Worker & Tinker Gnomes are generally happy, hardworking folks that love nothing more then to keep moving, working insane hours, they were bred and created to build things, construct, design, work, work, work. Mad Gnomes are those that developed Insanities and disabilities from the experiments and since its genetic their offspring tend to be mad as well. The Dwarves hate and mistreat Mad Gnomes on the regular, but other gnomes take extreme pity on them and help them to live and survive.
backstory: Gnomes are the creation of a Gene-splicer remembered only as The Master and were created to do his bidding. He had kidnapped thousands of Dwarves and performed what he called The Procedure, which transformed them into tiny little helpers that had an insatiable need to work all the time. The Gnomes gained their independence when Paragon Bright Stone of the Smith Caste defeated and slayed The Master, hurling him into an underground volcano. He then fought for the rights of the gnomes to live among the Dwarves, until his assassination ten years later, however the assassination backfired, instead turning him into a martyr. The Dwarven Council passed the law making gnomes a caste in Dwarven society the next day. Gnomes have since become renowned tinkerers and love their Dwarven brethren.

name: Halfling / Hobbit
description: Hobbits are jolly little plump humanoids, with slightly pointed ears and large hairy feet. They live in large communities in shires, foothills and lowlands, always near a freshwater supply. The entire race is addicted to an herb they cultivate known as Hobbit leaf, the leaf is brewed into teas, baked into almost every dish, is used as a seasoning and is dried and smoked out of pipes. The leaf is marijuana and the hobbits have been on it for thousands of years, they are carefree, hungry, shoe-less people just trying to get by man, chill dude, smoke this and let’s eat some pie my mom made, it’s the bomb.
backstory: There are two Shires and the Tribe on earth, the Shire of Glennwood California outside Toon Town and Hobbiton in Ireland. The two are extremely different, the folk of Glennwood are your classic happy go lucky Halflings. The Hobbits in Hobbiton have been fighting an endless battle since their Shire was magically placed on earth. The Shire is heavily fortified and it folk are hardened and grizzled, fore you see the kingdom of Slogg was also rifted into the Wick low mountains and has nowhere else to go except through the hobbits, the goblins have deforested everything up to the Shire and need the trees from the forest on the far side of the shire. The war has been raging for over 50 years. The Tribe as it is quaintly known is a sub-race of hobbits that are part of the Dwarven tribes of Mega City 21. They are barbarians and fierce mounted warriors that frequently raid, pillage and kill other humanoids in their way or that have something they want.

name: Walkers
description: Walkers resemble humans in every way; in fact they were once Human. They however look like the walking dead or zombies. Their skin is tight, pale and covered in open gashes and wounds. *Walkers are not actual Undead and are not affected by Spell, Magics, Powers and Abilities that affect undead, Necromancers cannot take control of them, etc.
backstory:
Long ago in a dimension slightly adjacent to ours a race of humans discovered a “Way” to bring the dead back to life, in effect becoming immortal. However, a great war occurred between the Living and the Dead. For a hundred years they fought but with every death of the living the ranks of the dead swelled. The humans released a deadly experimental weapon that created a small black hole leading to a dimension known as Necro-Space. This destroyed the entire planet, then collapsed in on itself, exploding into a large green cloud. The cloud expanded until everything in their dimension was Necro-Space. Walkers are the natural inhabitants of Necro-Space, sentient undead-like beings trying to survive.

When the apocalypse occurred on earth several Walker communities were deposited here and discovered life outside the cloud is far better. They are returning to a state of living the longer they exist in real space; after 100 years the Walker will once again be completely human and appear to be around 30 years old. Walkers can reproduce normally in real space, and there is about a 50% chance the baby will be completely human and not born a Walker.
lifespan: 100 and mature at 20 on earth; in Necro-Space you don’t age.

name: Shroomling
description: Shroomlings are bipedal humanoids that are one of the only known sentient plant-based lifeforms. They range in height, weight and body colors but always have a mushroom cap head covered in spots. Shroomlings feed on decay & death and will take the bodies of slain foes from the battlefield to eat. When feeding, a Shroomling will plant itself on / over the dead and accelerate the rate of decay by several dozen times, absorbing it in minutes.
backstory:
Shroomlings were created by Haoma, the Persian God of Plants, on a small planet in a faraway galaxy after the defeat of the Persian empire on earth. The planet was barren on the surface with harsh windstorms, and nothing could grow. Haoma lay deep in a cave slumbering for the rest of time. As the god slept, his life force and ability to accelerate plant growth allowed the cave system to burst into life. In decades, plants filled every subterranean space and pumped greenhouse gases onto the surface. After a few hundred years the planet was terraformed.

The dominant species evolved from plants feeding directly on the god’s sleeping body. As the planet grew it drew energy directly from the god, eventually killing him entirely. The god’s death began a collapse of the planet’s environment. The Shroomlings knew of the god’s portal back to earth and evacuated millions of their kin to Iran, now devastated by the apocalypse and infested with Gemanites. The New Persian Empire was quickly formed, setting up bases in old cities, working with surviving humans, and fighting back the Gemanites on every front.

name: Aquarians
description: Aquarians are large-headed aquatic fish bipedal humanoids; they range greatly in size and colors. They are bipedal fish with arms and legs. They have adapted special lungs that act as gills and lungs so they can breathe in and out of the water; however this adaptation makes their head bulbous and bouncy.
backstory:
The Aquarian home world is covered entirely in tropical waters and huge coral reefs. The predators of the planet are huge monsters that feed voraciously on the Aquarians, but Aquarians exist in the billions. When the tears on earth sparked to life they reached into the Aquarian dimension and tore from it their greatest settlement “The Great Reef” and deposited it off the coast of California. The seas around the west coast of America caused tidal waves that killed millions, changing the topography forever.

Aquarians are peaceful but territorial. They accept most other races into their community but are always threatened by the Lizard folk of the Dragon Isles and the World Spine. They accept Elves, Lizard folk, Orcs, Humans, Sprites—any kindhearted soul seeking refuge. However, since terror attacks have become more frequent, grown adults are kept under watch for months after they are admitted.

name: Orc
description: Orcs are humanoid pig-like humanoids that were created by an ancient evil wizard that has long been defeated. His creations, the Orcs, were banished to another dimension where they made a pact with a powerful Demonic God and now seek to conquer all.
backstory:
In the mid 1900s the Russian government discovered and activated a dimensional gate. They began sending teams and kidnapping Orcs for experimentation. After the apocalypse on earth, the first kidnapped Orc broke free, killed the base staff, and opened the gate allowing his brethren to flee to earth. So began the great Orc migration and Orcish-occupied Russia.

The remnants of the government were hunted down and destroyed. In desperation, the occult branch sacrificed hundreds of remaining citizens in a ritual to summon a huge demon “The Mos Cow”. This act backfired and it devoured the entire base and ravaged the countryside until killed and banished by the Orcs.

Orc tribes include: Bang Crank Uber (dominant; >60% of northern Russia), Broken Axe / Iron Bark / Torn Tusk (western Russia, constantly warring, including with Dwarves of Mozzark), Black Throne (eastern power, demon-pacted), and Deadwater Orcs (arrived with Lizardmen of the Dragon Isles; raiders of the seas).

name: Goblin
description: Goblins can range from small little humanoids to large oafs, but all are twisted mockery's of the human form. They have no genitalia and reproduce in mass spawning beds that can number in the thousands, creating a gross frothing mass.
backstory:
Goblins are a magically created race, made to reproduce at outstanding rates and flood their masters’ enemies relentlessly. Their creator got more than they bargained for: the goblins could reproduce and mature at a staggering pace, but they were incredibly stupid with voracious appetites. Their creator was devoured and the goblins flooded into the mines, destroying many Dwarven kingdoms before being held at bay.

After the apocalypse the goblin spawning pits reemerged deep in the bowels of the earth and provide excellent hosts for invading Gemanites. Goblins are the only race other than humans that can be found almost anywhere in the world; they tunnel up from deep underground in search of food. They are also the primary hosts for most of the Gemanites, and many large Gemanite veins can be found near every spawning ground.

There are two Goblin kingdoms on earth: one in the Grand Canyon (now called Grul Bondulslop), ruled by King Overlord Bondulslop the 30th, home to millions of cannibal goblins; and the Clack a Lack goblins of the Great Crack in California. Finally, the Black Throne is home to millions of goblins looking to please their masters.

name: Troll
description: Trolls are bipedal humanoids covered in a mossy-like hide that varies in color from gray to green. Males have tusks and females have wild hair; both genders take great pride in their hair, its length, and the wild styles it can be shaped into.
backstory:
The Trolls home world is one covered in lush tropical rain forests and huge oceans. The only reason trolls have visited earth is because the most heinous Trollish prisoners are banished in a voodoo ritual to another place—coincidentally earth. However the ritual also enlarges and deforms the prisoner into a monster, forced to hide under bridges and eat little girls, forever cursed on a strange world.

But we’re not talking about those trolls. The playable race Trolls are Jamaicans and inhabit what was the island of Jamaica or are part of the Black Throne horde, always working to please their masters.

During the apocalypse on earth a dimensional tear tore the jungle kingdom of Good Vibes and deposited it on our planet right next to Jamaica, effectively tripling the size of the country. The trolls were semi-subterranean and fled to their caves beneath the jungle. They accepted human refugees, integrating them into their culture as a subservient caste. Now they have emerged on their new home of Jamaica and fight to survive versus the isles’ new and old inhabitants.
racialSlot1: 1. Offensive Regeneration: When you hit with an attack, regenerate 1d4 HP. *Trigger can only occur once per round in combat.
2. Defensive Regeneration: When you are hit by an attack and take damage regenerate 1d4 HP. *Trigger can only occur once per round in combat.
3. Resistant Regeneration: When you are forced to make a Resist check, regenerate 1d6 HP. *Trigger can only occur once per round in combat.
4. TOR Regeneration: Regenerate 1d4 HP during Top of the Round. *Trigger can only occur once per round in combat.
5. BOR Regeneration: Regenerate 1d4 HP during Bottom of the Round. *Trigger can only occur once per round in combat.
6. AOE Regeneration: Regenerate 1d6 HP when you take damage from an AOE attack. *Trigger can only occur once per round in combat.
7. Spontaneous Regeneration: Regenerate DOT damage instead of being hurt by it. *Trigger can only occur once per round in combat.
8. Emergency Regeneration: Regenerate 1d10 HP whenever you fall below zero HP. *Trigger can only occur once per round in combat.

name: Kobold
description:
Kobolds are small bipedal humanoids that resemble a furry lizard or a scaly Wolfin and everything in between. They are adapted to living deep underground or on the surface; their sheer numbers and general stupidity and voraciousness are legendary.

Adventuring Kobolds are the small percentage of highly intelligent Kobolds that leave their horde in search of life, love and fortune. They can be loyal, trustworthy friends that want to experience things with those they can call friends. They retain a pack mentality, preferring to never be alone, and sometimes this means they throw in with the wrong crowd and can become evil just as easily.
backstory:
Kobolds are yet another magically created race intended to create a fast-breeding, high birth-cycle race. The gene-splicer responsible saw the flaws in goblins and decided they came from using too much human DNA, so they used canine and reptile DNA instead. Kobolds were created to mate, mate, mate, and so have ferocious sex drives.

Known collectives include: The Breeding Pit in Australia, The Goif in the Great Crack, and the Kingdom of Nief. The Kingdom of Nief is located under the Canadian wilderness. Vast, deep tunnels run from each settlement for hundreds of miles throughout Canada. The Kobold of Nief are different from their bestial brethren: they are a hierarchy society ruled by the mighty King Nief.
racialSlot1: 1. The Kobold Advantage: Gain Natural Navigator, Triple Jointed and From the Depths Adv.
2. Gemanite Infected: You are immune to Radiation & Mind Affecting Abilities and Mitigate 1 damage from all sources.

name: Lizard Folk
description:
Lizard folk are a race of bipedal reptiles. They come in dozens of species, but all are semi aquatic. Their home world is covered in 80% water and they are the top predator. Lizard folk are very aggressive and do not seek to coexist with any other races; they are conquerors, slavers and pirates of the seas.

Adventuring Lizard folk are those that want freedom and those that do seek to coexist with others. They can never return to the Isle once exiled or if they ran away. It’s quite frequent because Lizard folk also outcast unwanted children into the sea; the kind Aquarians find and raise the children as their own.
backstory:
During the apocalypse, several tears opened in earth’s oceans and millions of lizard folk were torn from their world and thrown into ours. Several species died immediately due to the inability to exist at such depths or in the high concentrations of salt in the water.

The remaining lizard folk found refuge in the currently expanding island chain of Hawaii, which had been ravaged by nuclear bombs that caused the dormant volcanoes to become active. Present day it is almost ten times its old size, stretching all the way to Fiji and is now known as the Dragon Isles.

The second community resides on a growing island chain of huge volcanoes and mountain ranges that have shot up between Africa and South America forming what is known as the World Spine. Both are matriarchal societies ruled by Clutch Queens.
skin: Any color and combination of colors are possible.

name: Wolfin
description: Wolfin are bipedal canine humanoids, not to be confused with werewolves or shapeshifters. On their home world they were a proud race that clawed its way up through the evolutionary ladder, reaching a level roughly equivalent to the Roman era on Earth.
backstory:
Fortune tellers and mages foresaw the destruction of their world. Wolfin leaders secretly gathered every Wolfin capable of magic, bound them, and forced them to perform an ancient ritual that teleported a hundred-mile radius of their empire to another dimension.

They were deposited into the Canadian wilderness and began anew. All magic in the Wolfin bloodline was eliminated; they actively hunt and destroy magic users. Young Wolfin who show magical talent are either taken in the night and never seen again or abandoned in the wilderness.

Their empire now resides in New Rome (what was Newfoundland) with nine major settlements across mainland Canada. Their goal is conquest and enslavement of other races.

name: Catling
description: Catlings are feline humanoids, not shapeshifters. Most on Earth are Alley Cats. They are masters of deception, stealth, manipulation, and commerce; superb merchants and con artists who love deals.
backstory: The Catlings were conquered by the Wolfin a thousand years ago. Instead of war, they negotiated integration as indentured servants who could earn second-class citizenship. Over time they prospered, forming secret councils, guilds, and clubs. They hold little resentment toward the Wolfin, whom they consider fair masters.

name: Insectz
description: Insectz are insect-like humanoids of many species, once the apex species of their homeworld before being nearly consumed by the Wyrmwood Hive Mind.
backstory:
The Insectz unified all insect species into one spacefaring civilization. They fought a thousand-year war against the Rodants. On the brink of extinction, an Insectz scientist released the Wyrmwood — a living rot that consumed entire planets and created a universal Hive Mind.

Modern Insectz are either Hive drones or refugees who escaped and now fight to free others.

name: Rodant
description: Rodants are rodent humanoids, commonly called Sewer Rats on Earth, but once a proud spacefaring civilization.
backstory:
The Rodants colonized and terraformed hundreds of planets, assimilating lesser races. Their downfall began on Luxury Prime (Planet 246), a paradise world that became infected by the Wyrmwood Rot.

The infected congress fled in starships and spread the corruption across all Rodant space, turning their entire empire into Hive drones.

name: Avians
description: Avians are sentient birdlike humanoids. Most are flightless due to their devastated homeworld, though some noble castes retained flight.
backstory:
Avians once lived in colossal sky-cities miles above the ground. A catastrophic meteor storm (Hulak Kajng — Reign of Fire) destroyed the surface world, leaving only subterranean cave-garden cities.

A noble caste called the White Feathers enslaved the cave Avians from above. When the Wyrmwood arrived, it spread rapidly through the sealed caves, assimilating nearly all Avians into the Hive Mind.

Modern Avians are refugees who broke free of the Wyrmwood and now fight to liberate their kin.
